name: O-2390
summary: O-2390 (3,4-Dichloro-alpha-PVP, DCPVP) is a recreational designer drug from the substituted cathinone family, which acts as a potent inhibitor of dopamine and noradrenaline reuptake in vitro, with weaker but still significant inhibition of serotonin reuptake.

pharmacology.text: O-2390 (3,4-Dichloro-alpha-PVP, DCPVP) is a recreational designer drug from the substituted cathinone family, which acts as a potent inhibitor of dopamine and noradrenaline reuptake in vitro, with weaker but still significant inhibition of serotonin reuptake.

uses.text: O-2390 (3,4-Dichloro-alpha-PVP, DCPVP) is a recreational designer drug from the substituted cathinone family, which acts as a potent inhibitor of dopamine and noradrenaline reuptake in vitro, with weaker but still significant inhibition of serotonin reuptake.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cathinones, can cause a fast heart rate, raised blood pressure, overheating, agitation, paranoia, sleeplessness and a strong urge to keep redosing, and in serious cases seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的合成卡西酮類藥物，可能引起心跳過快、血壓上升、體溫過高、激動、妄想、失眠以及強烈想要追加使用的衝動，嚴重時會出現癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的合成卡西酮类药物，可能引起心跳过快、血压上升、体温过高、激动、妄想、失眠以及强烈想要追加使用的冲动，严重时会出现癫痫发作。

fact.en: It is alpha-PVP with two chlorine atoms added to the ring. The O codes mark compounds from Organix Inc, a company that supplies research chemicals to laboratories.
fact.zh: 它是在 α-PVP 的環上加了兩個氯原子。「O」開頭的編號代表來自 Organix 公司的化合物，該公司為實驗室供應研究用化學品。
fact.zhHans: 它是在 α-PVP 的环上加了两个氯原子。「O」开头的编号代表来自 Organix 公司的化合物，该公司为实验室供应研究用化学品。
